cluster: kind-ax-next-dev (OrbStack kernel 7.2.9, nfs-utils 2.6.2), dev NFS server 10.96.200.49:/memory, NFSv4.2
setup: one pod, one NFS mount: a root container swaps .shared/sf_x/a between the real dir and a symlink to an outside dir (readable by uid 1000) every ~200us; a uid-1000 container reads .shared/sf_x/a/b/file.txt
nosymfollow_spike: kubelet PV mount had nosymfollow; the container's bind mount did not (ro,relatime) and a planted absolute symlink was followed
